description_en: Queries the basic information and running status of a real-time task. Available since v6.4.0
description_zh: 查询实时任务基本信息和运行状态，上线版本：v6.4.0
name: GetStreamTask

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Dataphin project to which the task belongs. This parameter is used for project permission verification
parameters.help_zh: 任务所属的Dataphin项目ID，用于项目权限校验
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: Instance ID of the real-time task instance. Instance ID starts with t_ and is not a node ID or a file ID
parameters.help_zh: 实时任务实例ID，以t_开头，不是节点ID或文件ID
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The environment to query. Valid values: DEV for the development environment, and PROD for the production environment. If this parameter is not specified, the gateway defaults to PROD. The value is case-insensitive
parameters.help_zh: 查询环境：DEV开发环境、PROD生产环境；不传时网关默认PROD，支持大小写
parameters.name: env

Data.description_en: The basic information and running information of the real-time task instance. The fileId can be used to subsequently query operation records and historical running instances
Data.description_zh: 实时任务实例的基本信息和运行信息，fileId 可用于后续查询操作记录和历史运行实例

ConsumeLocationDate.description_en: The time corresponding to the latest read position. The format is yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss. If no consumption metrics are available, the value is null
ConsumeLocationDate.description_zh: 最新读取位置对应的时间，格式 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss；无消费指标时为null
ConsumeLocationDate.title_en: 最新读取位置对应的时间
ConsumeLocationDate.title_zh: 最新读取位置对应的时间

EngineVersion.description_en: The database engine version of the compute DPI engine used to run the node
EngineVersion.description_zh: 任务运行使用的计算引擎版本
EngineVersion.title_en: 任务运行使用的计算引擎版本
EngineVersion.title_zh: 任务运行使用的计算引擎版本

FileId.description_en: The ID of the task file. This corresponds to the FileId request parameter in ListStreamOpsRecords and ListStreamInstanceRecords. It is not a nodeId or a template file ID
FileId.description_zh: 任务文件ID，对应 ListStreamOpsRecords 和 ListStreamInstanceRecords 的 FileId 入参；不是 nodeId 或模板文件ID

Name.description_en: The name of the node to which the real-time task belongs
Name.description_zh: 实时任务所属的节点名称
Name.title_en: 实时任务所属的节点名称
Name.title_zh: 实时任务所属的节点名称

NodeId.description_en: The ID of the node. The ID starts with n_ and identifies a development node. It is different from the task file ID
NodeId.description_zh: 节点ID，以 n_ 开头；标识研发节点，与任务文件ID不同

OperatorId.description_en: The ID of the user who last operated the task
OperatorId.description_zh: 最近一次操作该任务的用户ID
OperatorId.title_en: 最近一次操作该任务的用户ID
OperatorId.title_zh: 最近一次操作该任务的用户ID

OperatorName.description_en: The display name of the user who last operated the task
OperatorName.description_zh: 最近一次操作该任务的用户显示名称
OperatorName.title_en: 最近一次操作该任务的用户显示名称
OperatorName.title_zh: 最近一次操作该任务的用户显示名称

ProjectId.description_en: The ID of the Dataphin project to which the task belongs
ProjectId.description_zh: 任务所属的 Dataphin 项目ID
ProjectId.title_en: 任务所属的 Dataphin 项目ID
ProjectId.title_zh: 任务所属的 Dataphin 项目ID

ProjectMode.description_en: The project mode. Valid values: BASIC for the basic mode, and DEV_PROD for the development-production isolation mode
ProjectMode.description_zh: 项目模式：BASIC 为基础模式，DEV_PROD 为开发生产隔离模式

ProjectName.description_en: The name of the Dataphin project to which the task belongs
ProjectName.description_zh: 任务所属的 Dataphin 项目名称
ProjectName.title_en: 任务所属的 Dataphin 项目名称
ProjectName.title_zh: 任务所属的 Dataphin 项目名称

ResourceQueue.description_en: The display information of the resource queue used by the task, including the queue name and ID
ResourceQueue.description_zh: 任务使用的资源队列展示信息，包含队列名称及ID
ResourceQueue.title_en: 任务使用的资源队列展示信息
ResourceQueue.title_zh: 任务使用的资源队列展示信息

Status.description_en: The running status of the task. The original TaskStatusEnum enumeration name is returned. Common real-time statuses include: STREAMING_STARTING (starting), STREAMING_RUNNING (running), STREAMING_PAUSING (pausing), STREAMING_PAUSED (paused), STREAMING_RESUMING (resuming), STREAMING_STOPPING (stopping), STREAMING_STOPPED (stopped), STREAMING_INIT (initial status), STREAMING_FAILED (running exception), STREAMING_START_FAILED (start exception), STREAMING_RESUME_FAILED (resume exception), and STREAMING_FINISHED (completed). Other known statuses also return the original enumeration name. If the status cannot be identified, UNKNOWN is returned. If the original status is empty, null is returned
Status.description_zh: 任务运行状态，返回原始 TaskStatusEnum 枚举名。常见实时状态：STREAMING_STARTING启动中、STREAMING_RUNNING运行中、STREAMING_PAUSING暂停中、STREAMING_PAUSED已暂停、STREAMING_RESUMING恢复中、STREAMING_STOPPING停止中、STREAMING_STOPPED已停止、STREAMING_INIT初始状态、STREAMING_FAILED运行异常、STREAMING_START_FAILED启动异常、STREAMING_RESUME_FAILED恢复异常、STREAMING_FINISHED已完成；其他已知状态同样返回原始枚举名，无法识别时返回UNKNOWN，原始状态为空时返回null

TaskId.description_en: Instance ID of the real-time task instance. Instance ID starts with t_ and corresponds to the TaskId request parameter in GetStreamTask
TaskId.description_zh: 实时任务实例ID，以 t_ 开头；对应 GetStreamTask 的 TaskId 入参

Type.description_en: The type of the task, such as REAL_TIME_PIPELINE (real-time integration), FLINK_SQL (SQL task), FLINK_TEMPLATE_SQL (template task), and FLINK_DATASTREAM (DataStream task)
Type.description_zh: 任务类型，如 REAL_TIME_PIPELINE（实时集成）、FLINK_SQL（SQL任务）、FLINK_TEMPLATE_SQL（模板任务）、FLINK_DATASTREAM（DataStream任务）

Data.title_en: 查询实时任务基本信息和运行状态
Data.title_zh: 查询实时任务基本信息和运行状态

Message.description_en: The details of the backend response exception

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
